Oceanside.behaviour_data: no striking or reducing filter offered

compatibility_note: Kugler states its colours work with virtually all 96 COE batch and cullet in use today, and that COE is not necessarily a representation of compatibility. Reichenbach and Gaffer are likewise sold as soft glass colours for use over a compatible base. Test every colour against your own batch. None of this is the tested-compatible guarantee that the kiln glass module carries.
behaviour_note: Striking colours develop their target colour with heatwork and look wrong when cold. Reducing colours need a reducing atmosphere to bring the metallic surface up. Only Kugler publishes this per colour on the listings we have. Reichenbach and Gaffer behaviour is blank, not absent: fill it in from your own bench notes.
price_note: Retailer prices per kilogram: Kugler from Hot Glass Color, Reichenbach and Gaffer from Olympic Color Rods. Blank means the listing showed no price. These change; treat as relative.
